documents.text: nginx systemd service inactive and port 80 closed; HTTP requests failed; restarting nginx restored the listener and service active state
docker daemon inactive; MySQL container became unreachable and TCP port 3306 refused connections; restarting docker restored MySQL connectivity
redis service failed and port 6379 was not listening; restarting redis restored the cache service and TCP connectivity
postgresql became inactive and clients received connection refused on port 5432; restarting postgresql restored the database listener
sshd inactive and TCP port 22 closed; remote login failed until the ssh service was restarted and the listener recovered
nginx remained active and port 80 was open, but reverse proxy requests returned 502 upstream connection errors after a backend restart
rabbitmq service was active but queue consumers stopped acknowledging messages; restarting rabbitmq recovered consumer delivery
elasticsearch cluster health turned red and search requests timed out; restarting the affected elasticsearch node restored search responses
